connector.name: Algovoi MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: AlgoVoi crypto payments via MCP: USDC + native on Algorand, VOI, Hedera, Stellar.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the chopmob-cloud account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ALGOVOI_API_KEY
env.description: Your AlgoVoi API key (algv_...) from https://dash.algovoi.co.uk.

env.name: ALGOVOI_API_BASE
env.description: AlgoVoi API base URL. Default cloud.algovoi.co.uk (managed payouts) or api1.ilovechicken.co.uk.

env.name: ALGOVOI_TENANT_ID
env.description: Tenant UUID. Required only for direct API access. Leave unset when using AlgoVoi Cloud.

env.name: ALGOVOI_PAYOUT_ADDRESS
env.description: Default payout wallet address. Required only for direct API access; managed in Cloud otherwise.

env.name: ALGOVOI_WEBHOOK_SECRET
env.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 secret for webhook verification. Enables the verify_webhook tool.
